markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (85%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Normal (14%) alongside Benign, with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 85%, Normal 14%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign over Normal; non-invasive |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% coverage target) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 64th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical image quality; not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 3/5 Normal [F5] | Neighbors split Normal vs Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 2, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-1.45) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical infiltration score (+0.71) pushing toward invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical stroma/fat score (-0.57) opposing invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Sampled cell fractions** (regions 3, 8, 11) · context · 96th-percentile immune (14% [F7]), 97th-percentile dead (5% [F8]), 0% epithelium [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test data (deleting top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random; 95% CI excludes zero).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI includes zero); this read relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal: 3/5 nearest neighbors (including top match BACH_0236 at 92% similarity) are Normal.
- Focal pathology is missed: regions 0, 2, 8 score high for infiltration while cell sampling lacked tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 8**: Inspect stroma for true infiltration versus benign sclerosing change; region 8 has highest risk.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 11**: Verify benign lesion versus normal lobules, since the normal-lobules concept is unreliable.
3. **Regions 3, 8, 11**: Check inflammation, cellular debris, and sparse epithelium where HoVer-Net flagged insufficient tumor nuclei.
